eps.ov: A subordinate of the Demon King falls in love with a priestess in the hero's party.

eps.t: I Tried Going on a Date
eps.ov: Celia asks Yoki to take Cecilia out on a date as a break from her daily stresses and obligations.
While Yoki is helping Raven win over his crush, they run into another old friend in need of love advice.

eps.t: I Gave the Hero a Lecture
eps.ov: After Raven and Mikana, Yuga is next to seek advice from Yoki.

eps.t: I Tried Being a Demon Again
eps.ov: While helping a village that's been attacked by bandits, Yoki and Cecilia encounter a new threat.
Teal takes a turn for the worse, and at the same time, Gar is in peril. Can Yoki save both of them in time?
Valentine's Day is for giving chocolate to someone special, but not everyone agrees.
Yoki accepts a quest to stop a string of thefts on merchant ships in a port town.

eps.t: I Tried Learning More About the Girl I Love
eps.ov: Yoki realizes he doesn't know much about Cecilia, so he tries going on a quest with her to learn more.

eps.t: I Tried Hearing Out the Guardian Deity's Troubles
eps.ov: Gar decides to work and make money on his own to repay his debt to Teal.

eps.t: I Tried Watching Over My Friend and My Former Subordinate
eps.ov: Raven starts to feel like his own weakness and powerlessness are hurting his chances with Happiness.

eps.t: I Tried Listening to My Crush's Arranged Marriage Plan
eps.ov: Cecilia is meeting the man that the king wants her to marry. How will Yoki take the news?

eps.t: I Tried Being in a... with My Crush
eps.ov: A mysterious figure who looks just like Yoki's alter-ego is causing chaos in the capital.
